prompts.title: Nano Banana 的电影夜景提示
prompts.description: 一个给 Nano Banana 的提示：创建一个电影般的夜景，画面中一位衣着考究的男士斜倚在一辆红色复古轿车旁，旁边是一个神秘发光的女性剪影，强调戏剧性的灯光和电影剧照美学。
prompts.content: A cinematic night scene on a quiet city street under warm streetlights. A well-dressed man in a black suit with a loosened tie leans casually against a red vintage sedan, hands in his pockets, looking sideways with a thoughtful expression. Beside him stands a mysterious glowing female silhouette, her entire body emitting bright white light with no visible facial features, wearing a short red dress. The red vintage car is parked along the roadside near a brick wall and iron fence, with trees and soft street lighting creating a moody atmosphere. Film still aesthetic, dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, realistic shadows, cinematic color grading, nighttime urban vibe.
